prds.title: Command Utility requirements
prds.problem: A small command-led tool for transforming or inspecting text.
prds.audience: Obsidian users who need start here for a focused utility rather than a large workspace.
prds.goals: Start here for a focused utility rather than a large workspace.
prds.nonGoals:
Bind the active editor or selection through host APIs
Implement the transformation and preserve undo history
prds.notes: All requirements are designed, not implemented or verified.

requirements.title: Text utility
requirements.acceptance: Given the text utility surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Result preview
requirements.acceptance: Given the result preview surface, when the primary user action succeeds, then show the updated result; on failure preserve the draft and show a recoverable error. Implement the domain-specific assertions before marking this requirement complete.

requirements.title: Native lifecycle and data safety
requirements.acceptance: Given the plugin is enabled then disabled, all subscriptions, timers and UI resources are released; no unrelated notes or settings are changed.

requirements.title: Isolated acceptance
requirements.acceptance: Given an isolated development vault and synthetic data, verify the intended outcome with a failing test before implementing it. Scaffold tests and synthetic examples do not satisfy this acceptance.
